thesis: The speakers argue that rebalance timing luck is a dramatically misunderstood and ignored source of risk in portfolios, particularly those using systematic rebalance processes or common benchmarks. They explain that this risk arises because the timing of when a portfolio is rebalanced can significantly impact returns, even when the underlying construction process remains identical.
